blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate Electoral Tribunal on Friday junked another version of the quo warranto petition to unseat Sen. Erwin Tulfo. This form of petition challenges an individuals s right to hold a public office. Berteni Causing filed this case versus Tulfo on grounds of supposed “disloyalty to the Philippines and allegiance to the […]...
